name: rea-games
description: Reverse-engineer a game's behavior, rebuild it in any engine, and prove the rebuild matches the original frame by frame.

interface.shortDescription: Rebuild a game from behavior and prove it matches frame by frame
interface.longDescription: Reverse-engineer a game's behavior, rebuild it in any engine (web, Godot, Bevy, Unity), and prove the rebuild matches the original frame by frame. Records inputs and state from the original, writes a behavior spec, builds the port, and verifies case by case.
